name: Scheduled Caste Dashamottar Scholarship (Starting from Class 11) - Uttarakhand
benefit:
***The total scholarship amount determined by the districts = Educational Allowance + Tuition Fee.***
***Group 1:***
Professional courses at undergraduate and postgraduate levels

  - Hostellers: ₹13,500/-
  - Day Scholars: ₹7,000/-

***Group 2:***
Other Professional Courses leading to Degree, Diploma, Certificate

  - Hostellers: ₹9,500/-
  - Day Scholars: ₹6,500/-

***Group 3***
Undergraduate an
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must belong to the Scheduled Caste (SC) category. 1. The applicant must be enrolled in a recognized school/educational institution in Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be studying in Class 11 or higher level course. 1. The applicant must possess valid documents, such as Caste Certificate, Residence Certificate, Bank Passbook, Aadhaar, Photograph, Educational Qualification Certificates, and Income Certificate. 1. The total annual income of the parents/guardians from all sources must not exceed ₹2.5 lakh. 1. The scholarship will be available for one year only for studying in any class.
